title: Anote Coding Task Record
description: Schema for a single dataset record built from a Terminal-Bench / Harbor task.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task, matching its name in the source repo

instruction.description: The task prompt, copied verbatim from the task's instruction.md.

metadata.description: Descriptive info about the task, copied from task.toml [metadata].

author_name.description: Original task author, copied from task.toml.

difficulty.description: Difficulty label as given in task.toml. Normalize to these 3 values even if source uses different casing/wording.

category.description: Task category as given in task.toml (e.g. 'debugging', 'question-answering'). Copy as-is; normalize spelling/casing across tasks as a team.

tags.description: Keyword tags from task.toml, copied as an array.

solution.description: Reference/oracle solution, copied verbatim from the task's solve.sh (or solution.sh).

test_script.description: Raw verifier script, copied verbatim from the task's test.sh (or test_outputs.py).
